name: How should I prepare before requesting an interior remodeling quote?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare before requesting an interior remodeling quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting a remodeling company, list your functional pain points, collect visual inspiration, and establish a comfortable spending range. Document what does not work in your current layout, such as inadequate kitchen storage or an inaccessible bathtub. Measuring key spaces and gathering reference photos helps project managers understand your vision right away. Clarifying whether you want immediate cosmetic updates or long-term accessibility improvements will guide realistic project planning from the start.
acceptedAnswer.description: Identify current functional issues, gather design inspiration photos, define your target budget, and decide whether your focus is aesthetic updates or major layout changes.
